integrity.claim_scope: Exact all-orders inclusion probability and strict disjoint projected-edge covariance
integrity.finite_validation: 6312 quotient-tree matching-event comparisons and 6 physical-edge enumerations

scientific_limitations: Uniform physical interconnection trees on complete multipartite graphs only.
Exact inclusion law for matchings of projected index pairs, not arbitrary projected forests or physical edge sets.
Uses and credits earlier exact total count and fixed-quotient realization weights of Demange and Strozecki.
Potential unindexed capacity-weighted Cayley-tree equivalent remains a bibliographic risk.
No independent external audit or validation has been performed.
title: Matching-pattern correlations in uniform interconnection trees
